weather_summary.mt-hood: Sunny at lower elevations, snow above 6000ft

event.title: USA Dodgeball Premier Tour
event.why: National tour stop with division-based competitive dodgeball. Cheap to walk in and check out — high-energy, kid-friendly, weird enough to be fun if you're bored.

featured_venues.name: Oregon Convention Center
featured_venues.where: 777 NE Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Portland

items.title: Portland Saturday Market
items.why: The granddaddy of PNW open-air markets. Memorial Day weekend usually brings extra vendors and live music on the waterfront stage.

items.title: Beach day at Manzanita
items.why: Long, quiet beach with the Neahkahnie headland framing the south end. Less of a circus than Cannon Beach on a holiday weekend.
items.weather_rationale: 62° with light wind on the coast — borderline but bearable in layers.

items.title: Edgefield's History & Art Tour
items.where: McMenamins Edgefield, 2126 SW Halsey St, Troutdale
items.why: Guided walk through the 1911 Poor Farm grounds with stories behind the art, the buildings, and the murals tucked into every nook. Great way to see Edgefield beyond just the food and beer.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny and 74° — perfect for a walking tour outdoors.
items.image_hint: edgefield manor troutdale historic estate gardens

items.title: Grand Lodge Garden Experience
items.where: McMenamins Grand Lodge, 3505 Pacific Ave, Forest Grove
items.why: 20 minutes from home and most people in Hillsboro have never wandered the Grand Lodge gardens. Pair it with lunch in the pub. Cheap, easy, scratches the McMenamins itch.
items.image_hint: grand lodge forest grove gardens rhododendrons

items.title: Latourell Falls loop
items.where: Historic Columbia River Highway, near Corbett
items.why: Easy loop past the 249-ft Latourell Falls and a smaller upper falls. Less crowded than Multnomah on holiday weekends.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny and warm in the Gorge — perfect hike weather.

items.title: Memorial Weekend in Wine Country
items.why: Three-day open-house weekend across dozens of wineries — barrel tastings, library releases, food trucks. The big one of the spring calendar.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny mid-70s in the valley — patio-tasting weather.

items.title: Lan Su Chinese Garden
items.why: A full city block of authentic Ming-dynasty garden tucked inside downtown. Most Portlanders haven't been. Tea house upstairs.
items.weather_rationale: Outdoor garden — a sunny day makes it shine.

items.title: Trillium Lake loop + Mt. Hood views
items.why: Flat boardwalk loop around a mirror lake with Mt. Hood reflected straight on. One of the most photographed spots in Oregon for a reason.
items.weather_rationale: Clear at lower elevations — Hood will be unobstructed.

items.title: The Oregon Garden in Silverton
items.why: 80 acres of specialty gardens — kid-sized adventure garden, sensory garden, conifer collection. Pair with lunch at the resort restaurant.
items.weather_rationale: Mid-70s in the valley — peak garden weather.

items.title: Bush's Pasture Park + Deepwood
items.why: Historic 90-acre park with rose gardens, a Victorian mansion museum, and the Deepwood Museum gardens next door. Salem's quiet weekend gem.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny in Salem — outdoor garden weather.

items.title: Hood River waterfront + kiteboarding watch
items.where: Event Site & Waterfront Park, Hood River
items.why: Memorial Day weekend kicks off windsurf/kite season. Walk the waterfront, grab lunch at Pfriem or Solstice, watch the river show.
items.weather_rationale: Sunny and 78° in Hood River — peak conditions on the river.
